summary_1line: Bhishma teaches that the highest sacred pilgrimage is the inner 'Manasa Tirtha'—purity of mind and conduct—greater than external holy waters.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while instructing Yudhishthira about the invisible sacred lake of the mind called Manasa Tirtha.
A serene sage sits in meditation beside still water, symbolizing the inner lake of truth and understanding within the mind.
Pilgrims bathe in a river while a solitary ascetic purifies himself through meditation and self-denial on the riverbank.
